section.p: Consider an <h2> called "Install on Linux", the body contains a numbered list which indicates step-by-step procedure.

entry.codeblock:
Install on Linux

  1. Download the installer.
  2. Run the setup wizard.
  3. Restart the service.

<task id="install_on_linux"> <title>Install on Linux</title> <taskbody> <steps> <step> <cmd>Download the installer.</cmd> </step> <step> <cmd>Run the setup wizard.</cmd> </step> <step> <cmd>Restart the service.</cmd> </step> </steps> </taskbody> </task>

section.p: Result: The converter classifies "Install on Linux" as a task topic because the heading contains an action verb, and an <ol> list is the primary body content. Each <li> element is mapped to a <step><cmd> element inside <steps>.
